en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Sali, and Jameel Bin Darraj, and Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a wife of the man who happens to have a servant for her who had been immoral, so he became needy to her milk. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Instruct her such, so she would permit her in order to make her milk to be good’.
